title: Console: Dedicated staged rollouts list + detail page, approvals modal, abort flow
author: Hannah Rivera
description: Adds the Console UI for Dedicated staged rollouts: (1) per-pool rollout list view, (2) rollout detail page with stage timeline + gate badges and evaluation summaries, and (3) manual approvals + abort flow via modals. This is the first end-to-end front-end for the Dedicated rollout experience behind the dedicatedRollouts feature flag + tenant allowlist (API enforces RBAC; UI hides/locks actions when permissions are missing). Scope intentionally matches beta requirements: deterministic staged rollouts, approvals, abort; does not include advanced gate editing beyond defaults. UX notes: uses a compact stage timeline for quick scanning; gate state is color-coded with explicit “metrics missing” copy to avoid false confidence; approval is a “stop-the-line” affordance (primary CTA only when stage is in HOLD_PENDING_APPROVAL). Data model assumptions: consumes console-backend aggregation endpoint (PR #28519) for stage status + gate summaries; uses audit events endpoint for activity feed; uses approve/abort endpoints (PR #28462). Screenshots: added in review thread. Follow-ups (out of scope): inline gate threshold editing, A/B experiment linking, and customer-facing copy polish for GA. Test plan: manual smoke in staging (dogfood pool), unit tests for routing + permission gating, Playwright for approvals/abort happy path and error states. Risk: API lag / missing metrics -> UI shows “PAUSED (insufficient data)” and blocks advance; aligns with evaluator fail-safe behavior.
commits: console: add dedicated rollouts routes + navigation entry behind feature flag
ui: rollout list table w/ status pills, last updated, actor
ui: rollout detail page w/ stage timeline + gate badges + stage drawer
ui: approvals modal + abort confirmation modal w/ reason capture
client: add typed API client for rollouts + audit events w/ abort/approve mutations
tests: add Playwright coverage for approve/abort flows; fix flaky selector
polish: empty states, skeleton loading, error boundaries
snippets: Stage CTA gating (RolloutDetailPage.tsx): const canApprove = permissions.includes('rollout.approve') && stage.state === 'HOLD_PENDING_APPROVAL'; const canAbort = permissions.includes('rollout.abort') && rollout.state !== 'ABORTED' && rollout.state !== 'COMPLETED';
Gate badge copy for missing metrics (GateBadge.tsx): if (gate.status === 'NO_DATA') return <Badge tone="warning">Paused: metrics missing</Badge>;
conversation: Kenji Nakamura (review): The stage timeline reads well. Two nits: (1) the warning state for missing metrics should not use the same color as “gate failing”, and (2) the abort modal needs clearer copy that traffic returns to baseline immediately vs waiting for evaluator tick. Also please confirm keyboard focus trapping in both modals.

Hannah Rivera (author): Updated NO_DATA badge to warning amber and FAIL to red. Abort modal copy now says: “Abort stops stage advancement immediately; routing returns to baseline configuration within ~30s.” Focus trap: using Modal from @redwood/ui with aria-labelledby + initialFocus ref; added a quick a11y check in Playwright.
Dylan Brooks (review): Can we surface the actor for the latest approval in the stage header? That’s the first thing I look for during incidents. Also would like an explicit link to audit events feed.
Hannah Rivera (author): Added “Last action” row in stage drawer (actor + timestamp) and a “View activity” tab that loads audit events. Stage header now shows lastAction.actor when available.

Sean Gallagher (review): SRE feedback: in the error state when the aggregation endpoint fails, please show the pool + rollout id so oncall can correlate quickly. Also avoid auto-refresh hammering when backend is degraded.
Hannah Rivera (author): Added identifiers to the error boundary and implemented exponential backoff on polling (5s -> 10s -> 20s) with a hard cap; manual refresh button remains.

Marcus Lin (review): Permissioning: ensure UI does not attempt approve/abort if permissions missing; also ensure we don’t leak tenant/pool ids in toast errors across org boundaries (seen this before with shared error handler).

Hannah Rivera (author): Approve/abort buttons are not rendered without permissions; mutations are additionally guarded in the hooks. Toast now maps 403/404 to generic “Not authorized / Not found” without echoing ids; full details go to console log only in dev builds.
Chloe Martin (review): API integration looks fine. One suggestion: handle “plan_version conflict” by refetching and showing a banner rather than surfacing raw error text.
Hannah Rivera (author): Implemented conflict handling: on 409, refetch rollout, show banner “Rollout updated by another actor; view latest state before retrying.”
Kenji Nakamura (final): LGTM after the color + copy changes. Thanks for adding the activity tab.
Dylan Brooks (final): Approved. Please file a follow-up for gate threshold editing UI for GA.
Hannah Rivera (author): Follow-up filed in Linear (ENG-5135 referenced).
release_notes: Console (Dedicated): Added staged rollout list + detail views, manual stage approval UI, and abort rollout flow (feature-flagged; operator/allowlisted tenants only).
